steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Set up application package name com.youtubebackgroundplayer.app and app label.

steps.title: Setup API Schema
steps.description: Configure static offline schema as YouTube playback operates locally without external API backend.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set Android SDK target to 34 and compile settings with Java 8 support.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Permissions & Services
steps.description: Declare internet, background service, notification permissions, and components in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define Visual Resources
steps.description: Create application colors, strings, dark theme styles, and vector drawables.

steps.title: Design Layout Views
steps.description: Build user interface layouts for Main Web view, History Screen, and History list items.

steps.title: Implement SQLite History Model & Database
steps.description: Create database helper and model for local YouTube video playback history management.

steps.title: Implement History Adapter
steps.description: Create custom ListView adapter with delete callback for history items.

steps.title: Implement Foreground Audio Service
steps.description: Build media service with notification channel to maintain audio focus for background playback.

steps.title: Implement History Activity
steps.description: Develop UI handler for displaying, opening, and clearing saved playback history.

steps.title: Implement Main YouTube Activity
steps.description: Build native web container with custom client, back navigation, audio focus, and history logging.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Compile the complete application and assemble the APK.
